headline: Growth accelerates across revenue, margins, and profit
summary_short: American Water Works reported Q2 FY2026 diluted EPS of $1.61 (+61.0% q/q, +8.8% y/y) on revenue of $1,355M (+12.3% q/q, +6.2% y/y) and net income of $315M (+60.7% q/q, +9.0% y/y).
summary_long: Revenue of $1,355M rose 12.3% q/q and 6.2% y/y. Gross margin was 64.5% of revenue (vs 59.2% q/q, 62.4% y/y) and operating margin 40.0% (vs 32.4% q/q, 38.3% y/y). Diluted EPS of $1.61 rose 61.0% q/q and 8.8% y/y on net income of $315M (+60.7% q/q, +9.0% y/y). Cash rose to $191M, up 39.4% q/q and 103.2% y/y.
